Coogee beach reopened on Friday after closing on Thursday , when a whale carcass, believed to be a juvenile humpback, was found washed up in Lurline Bay, between Coogee and Maroubra beaches. items.title: Review: Experience: I’ve climbed Mount Everest 20 times

My father was a scout leader, and I was always outside, building dams and dens, sleeping out and hiding in trees. In my teens, family holidays were two weeks in Wales. At home, nature was my playground. When I was 17, a school friend took me to a climbing wall where he was a regular. The seven-time world champion believes it is right that F1 is to hold a race there despite criticism of the country’s human rights record. items.title: Review: Sharp drops for AI stocks overwhelm markets worldwide as oil prices jump
items.summary: Datacenter and chip costs fueled sharp decrease in AI sector although non-AI stocks still had a strong showing The latest shudder for stocks in the AI industry pulled markets lower worldwide on Thursday, while oil prices hit their highest levels since May on worries about the war with Iran . The S&P 500 fell 1.2% for its worst day since July, while the Nasdaq composite tumbled 2.6%. The weakness for tech stocks was so overwhelming that it masked strength for the rest of the US market, in which the majority of stocks actually rose. The Dow Jones Industrial Average added 11 points, or less than 0.1%. Continue reading...
